title: Cite Pretrain: Retrieval-Free Knowledge Attribution for Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2506.17585v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large language models can answer questions correctly and still hallucinate their citations. Most citation systems address this by retrieving documents at inference time. Retrieval adds latency and depends on external infrastructure. Retrieval noise can also affect the answer. We study whether LLMs can cite documents from their (continual) pretraining without test-time retrieval. We introduce CitePretrainBench to evaluate this setting. It includes Wikipedia, Common Crawl, and arXiv as real-world corpora and also includes novel, unseen documents. The benchmark includes short-form citation tasks for a single fact and long-form tasks for multiple facts. Continual-pretraining first binds factual knowledge to a persistent identifier for each document. Instruction tuning then teaches the model to put these identifiers in its answers as citations. Passive Indexing appends an identifier at the end of each document. Synthetic data used in Acti

translated_title: Cite Pretrain：面向大语言模型的无检索知识溯源方法
translated_abstract: 大语言模型能够正确回答问题，但仍然可能在引用上产生幻觉。大多数引用系统通过在推理时检索文档来解决这一问题，然而检索会增加延迟、依赖外部基础设施，且检索噪声还可能影响答案质量。我们研究了LLM能否在不进行测试时检索的情况下，直接从其（持续）预训练的语料中引用文档。我们提出了CitePretrainBench来评估这一设置，其中包括Wikipedia、Common Crawl和arXiv等真实世界语料库，还包含新颖的、模型未见过的文档。该基准涵盖针对单一事实的短文本引用任务和针对多事实的长文本引用任务。该方法首先在持续预训练阶段将事实知识绑定到每个文档的持久标识符上，然后通过指令微调教会模型在答案中输出这些标识符作为引用。Passive Indexing在每个文档末尾附加一个标识符，而合成数据则用于Acti（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出CitePretrainBench基准，通过在持续预训练阶段将事实知识与文档持久标识符绑定、再经指令微调，使大语言模型无需推理时检索即可直接在回答中生成可溯源的文档引用，从而避免检索带来的延迟、基础设施依赖和噪声问题。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces CitePretrainBench and a retrieval-free approach that binds factual knowledge to persistent document identifiers during (continual) pretraining and leverages instruction tuning, enabling LLMs to generate citations directly from their pretraining corpus without test-time retrieval.
